name: What are the differences between vinyl, wood, and fiberglass double-pane window frames?

mainEntity.name: What are the differences between vinyl, wood, and fiberglass double-pane window frames?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each frame material offers distinct characteristics. Vinyl frames are popular for their affordability, low maintenance, and good insulation properties. Wood frames provide a classic aesthetic and excellent natural insulation but require more maintenance. Fiberglass frames are highly durable, stable, resistant to warping, and offer strong thermal performance with minimal maintenance. The best choice depends on your budget, desired aesthetics, and long-term maintenance preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Vinyl is affordable and low-maintenance. Wood offers classic aesthetics and good insulation but requires maintenance. Fiberglass is durable, stable, and high-performing.
